subject: general
question: Which organ in the human body produces bile juice?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Liver.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **liver** secretes bile juice, which is a digesting juice.
 
• Bile is stored in the **gallbladder.**
 
• **Bilirubin and biliverdin**, as well as bile salts and cholesterol, make up bile juice.
 
• Bile juice helps in the **emulsification of fat.**
 
• Large fat globules are broken down into smaller globules by bile juice, making it easier for pancreatic enzymes to act on them.
 
• The human liver is the **largest gland in the body.**
 
• The liver is situated on the right side of the stomach.
 
• The main function of the liver is to **produce bile pigment.**
 
• **Ammonia and urea** are produced in the liver.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Insulin and Glucagon are the hormones secreted by the **pancreas.**
 
• The nutrients in digested food are absorbed from the **small intestine.**
 
• The **stomach** is a hollow organ that holds food while it is being mixed with stomach enzymes.
